Policies can be filtered using the expression in the following ways: - Filter by application: `setting.type.matches('^settings/gmail\\..*$')` - Filter by setting type: `setting.type.matches('^.*\\.service_status$')` - Filter by customer: `customer == "customers/{customer}"` Where `customer` is the `id` from the [Admin SDK `Customer` resource](https://developers.google.com/admin-sdk/directory/reference/rest/v1/customers). Example query: `member_key_id == 'member_key_id_value' && in labels && parent == 'customers/C046psxkn'`
